title: 第3章 生死一瞬
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
刺杀，来得比想象中要更快！

    陆舟瞳孔骤缩，体内气血几乎本能地涌动……

    他双腿陡然弹起，蹭地一下往后暴退，气血自肌肤浮现，为其带来了巨大的爆发力。

    “嗯？”

    那黑影迟疑一声，显然没想到陆舟动作会这么迅速。

    按照情报，对方分明只是一名九品中级武者才是，不可能有如此大的瞬间爆发力。

    黑影来不及多想，体内气血再次奔腾，速度暴涨，欺身而上，眨眼便追上了陆舟，当即探出右臂……

    陆舟心头一震。

    此等爆发，至少是七品武者！

    眼看那匕首再次来袭，他避无可避，急忙抬起左臂，气血充盈，灌注肌肤。

    噗！

    匕首直直刺入，鲜血飞溅。

    好在陆舟身体强度足够，硬生生扛住了这一下。

    他强行拧身，双腿发力，撞向了帐布，摔了出去。

    “来人！”他吼声喊道。

    七品武者，不可力敌！

    就算这刺杀是刘傲有意为之，对方也绝对不会让自己在大庭广众下被杀！

    然而，松懈的守备，短时间根本帮不到他。

    那杀手一击失利，再次袭来，想要速战速决。

    陆舟咬牙起身，毫无功法武技的他，只能凭借本能反应抵抗。

    瞬间，他的身上便留下了不少伤口，触目惊心！

    好在境界的提升，让他身体素质得到了蜕变，避开了致命伤。

    这时，已有士兵被惊动，朝着这里赶来。

    但在一位七品武者面前，这些士兵根本不够看，轻松便被那杀手击退。

    陆舟见状，心渐渐冷了下来。

    事发突然，但过去这么久，刘傲等人依旧没有现身……

    杀手再次逼近……

    失血过多的陆舟意识昏沉，后退不及，瘫坐在地，失去了反抗能力。

    八品对七品，终究是差距太大！

    “大胆！”

    眼看岌岌可危，忽然一声怒喝响起。

    一道人影迅速奔来，带起一阵劲风……

    随即，一杆银白长枪刺破空气，呼啸而来，枪身之上，内气涌动，势如破竹。

    那杀手大惊，连忙躲闪，但依旧被宛若惊雷般长枪划破腹部，鲜血溅射。

    眼见刺杀失败，其无比果决，迅速逃离。

    赶来之人却不敢深追，连忙来到浑身是血的陆舟身前，急忙询问：“王爷，没事吧。”

    同一时刻，又有另一道身影匆匆赶来：“周川，怎么回事？”
content_en:
The assassination came faster than expected!

    Lu Zhou's pupils shrank suddenly, and the energy and blood in his body surged almost instinctively...

    His legs suddenly bounced up and he suddenly retreated backwards. Qi and blood emerged from his skin, giving him huge explosive power.

    "Huh?"

    The black figure hesitated, obviously not expecting Lu Zhou to move so quickly.

    According to the intelligence, the opponent is clearly just a ninth-grade intermediate warrior, and it is impossible to have such a huge instant explosive power.

    The black shadow didn't have time to think too much. The energy and blood in his body surged again. His speed surged. He bullied himself forward and caught up with Lu Zhou in the blink of an eye. He immediately stretched out his right arm...

    Lu Zhou was shocked.

    Such an explosion must be at least a seventh-grade warrior!

    Seeing the dagger strike again, he couldn't avoid it and hurriedly raised his left arm, filling his skin with energy and blood.

    puff!

    The dagger stabbed straight in, causing blood to fly.

    Fortunately, Lu Zhou's body was strong enough to withstand this blow.

    He twisted his body forcibly, exerted force on his legs, hit the tent, and fell out.

    "Come here!" he shouted.

    A seventh-grade warrior is invincible!

    Even if this assassination was intentional by Liu Ao, the other party would never let him be killed in public!

    However, lax defense could not help him in the short term.

    The killer missed a blow and attacked again, hoping for a quick victory.

    Lu Zhou gritted his teeth and stood up. He had no martial arts skills and could only rely on instinctive reactions to resist.

    In an instant, many wounds were left on his body, which was shocking!

    Fortunately, the improvement of his realm allowed him to transform his physical fitness and avoid fatal injuries.

    At this time, soldiers were alerted and rushed towards here.

    But in front of a seventh-grade warrior, these soldiers were not enough to look at, and were easily repelled by the killer.

    When Lu Zhou saw this, his heart gradually became cold.

    The incident happened suddenly, but after so long, Liu Ao and others still didn't show up...

    The killer is approaching again...

    Lu Zhou, who had lost too much blood, was unconscious and unable to retreat in time. He collapsed on the ground and lost the ability to resist.

    After all, the gap between the eighth grade and the seventh grade is too big!

    "Be bold!"

    Seeing that they were in danger, an angry shout suddenly sounded.

    A figure rushed over quickly, bringing with it a strong wind...

    Immediately, a silver-white spear pierced the air and roared towards him. On top of the spear, the inner energy surged like a broken bamboo.

    The killer was shocked and quickly dodged, but his abdomen was still pierced by the spear like thunder, and blood splattered.

    Seeing that the assassination failed, he was extremely decisive and fled quickly.

    The people who came did not dare to pursue him. They quickly came to Lu Zhou who was covered in blood and asked hurriedly: "Your Majesty, are you okay?"

    At the same moment, another figure hurried over: "Zhou Chuan, what's going on?"
title_en: Chapter 3 A moment of life and death
